findings.message: The first peroxide charge is explicitly a 30% aqueous formulation, not unspecified H2O2. Preserve the formulation in the reagent identity.
The sulfuric acid is explicitly concentrated; the reagent field omits this condition.

findings.quote: the  mixture  was  poured  into  a  0.1  M  solution  of  NaOH  which  had  been  saturated  with  solid  NaCl  (50  mL)  and  EtOAc  (50  mL)
findings.message: The receiving medium consists of 50 mL of NaCl-saturated 0.1 M aqueous NaOH and 50 mL EtOAc. Representing NaCl as a separate workup addition obscures its pre-existing presence in the receiving solution. The transfer also needs explicit source and destination references to preserve the direction of pouring.

findings.quote: The  aqueous  and  organic  layers  were  partitioned  and  the  organic  layer  was  washed  with  brine  (1  x  30  mL),  dried  (Na2SO4)
findings.message: The organic phase is the phase carried forward through partitioning and washing. Its top/bottom position is unspecified, but its organic identity is supported; keep_phase should not be unknown.

patch.value: The receiving solution is described as "a  0.1  M  solution  of  NaOH  which  had  been  saturated  with  solid  NaCl  (50  mL)". The 50 mL is the volume of the saturated aqueous solution, not an amount of solid NaCl.
The receiving NaOH solution was already saturated with solid NaCl. Its formulation is represented in the solution charge; the prior saturation operation has no supported operation or endpoint field.
